changes.description: The Preview draws a line from each point to the candidate it would be measured to, eligible candidates strong and the rest faint.

evidence.note:
Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently. 0.6.0: tests/distances-as-table.test.mjs checks the table and that a table port takes a distances result; tests/sea-level-from-scratch.browser.mjs builds both sea-level workflows on it (Chromium).

THE PREVIEW (2026-11-25). Browser tested on Chromium: tests/measure-distance-preview.browser.mjs drives four candidates to two and then to none, and asserts that every point then reports no distance. NOT established: that the preview's distances equal the run's to the last digit, which would need a test holding both. 0.7.1: the Chromium gate, 2026-11-26, with the browser tests that open its Inspector and Configure…; nothing it shows or does was meant to change. NOT established: WebKit, which CI runs.

THE PREVIEW DRAWS (2026-11-28). tests/measure-distance-preview.browser.mjs: three lines, four candidates strong, then two strong and two faint under a condition, then no line where none is eligible; Chromium, 2026-11-28, failing on the code before. NOT established: WebKit, which CI runs.
